recent_changes.description: Phase 07: Integration Testing E2E. Automated and manual testing of Bot Revamp. 14/14 deterministic integration tests passed.

Phase 06b: Integrated n8n Crawler Infrastructure. Deployed n8n into docker-compose and created webhook endpoint /api/crawler/webhook with auth and C1 input validation for resilience against malformed bot data.

Phase 06: Implemented Global Chatbot Personalization. Wired up DB persistence for chat history, integrated Analyst Bot market data strictly into LLM context to prevent hallucination, built history endpoints, and enhanced the frontend UI with badges and seamless load state.
Phase 05: Analyst Bot completed. Uses Prisma _avg/_count to build verifiable real estate market reports.

decisions_made.reason: Chat LLM queries the MarketReport table to enrich context safely, strictly isolating opinions from real data.
Ensures no bad data enters the Next.js system if the n8n bot malfunctions or the webhook is hit by malicious requests.
